blurb: They offer private fishing charters suitable for anglers of all ages and skill levels. Trips include inshore flats and backcountry fishing on local rivers and lagoons targeting species like Sea trout, Redfish, and Snook. They also provide nearshore and offshore blue water fishing for species such as Kingfish, Mahi Mahi, and Sailfish.

checkin: Thank you for booking your fishing trip with Slightly Obsessed Fishing Charters! We’re excited to have you onboard and look forward to a great day on the water. Fuel, fishing licenses, rods, cooler with ice, reels, lures, and bait are included in the trip Be sure to bring sunscreen, polarized sunglasses, a hat, weather-appropriate gear, food and drinks for the duration of your trip.
cancellation: Captain Eric reserves the right to change or cancel trips due to inclement weather. If the trip is cancelled by the captain, a full refund will be issued, or the trip rescheduled. Cancellation by the client within 7 days of the trip will result in forfeiture of your deposit. Cancellation within 24 hours of the trip by the client or no call/no show will result in the full price of trip due.
